documents.title: Shipping windows
documents.text: Standard delivery takes four to six business days. Express delivery takes one to two business days.

documents.title: Return policy
documents.text: Unused items may be returned within thirty days. Final-sale items are not eligible for return.

documents.title: Account security
documents.text: Reset the password and revoke active sessions after an unfamiliar account login.

documents.title: Baggage allowance
documents.text: Economy fares include one carry-on bag. Checked baggage depends on route and fare class.

documents.title: Flight changes
documents.text: Flexible fares permit itinerary changes before departure without a change fee.

documents.title: Delay support
documents.text: Travelers delayed overnight may request hotel and meal assistance at the service desk.
